title: DasherControl, a dashboard for your homelab

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: You've got a homelab full of services, and a dozen browser tabs to reach them. What if they all lived in one saved workspace?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: That's DasherControl. It gathers homelab links and embedded applications into workspaces you can save and come back to.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Three clean pieces. A Vue three interface on the front, a Rust and Rocket API in the middle, and PostgreSQL storing the layout through Diesel.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: It has its own separate path. The Rust backend talks to the Docker daemon, so the dashboard can control containers without tangling that with the layout code.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: So the screen, the data and the container control each stay in their own lane.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Right. Clear boundaries make the whole thing easy to follow. The full write-up has the diagrams.
